description: This file is part of the vtiger CRM project, handling pre-migration tools including database health checks, backups, and database copying, with embedded JavaScript for UI interactions.

methods.name: fixDBHealth
methods.description: Performs database health fix by calling VerifyDBHealth.php via AJAX and updates UI based on response.

methods.name: viewDBReport
methods.description: Opens a new window to display the database health report.

methods.name: getDbDump
methods.description: Initiates a database dump download by opening a new window.

methods.name: doDBCopy
methods.description: Copies the database to a new database using AJAX, with validation and UI updates.

methods.name: showCopyPopup
methods.description: Displays the database copy popup dialog.
